objective: Evaluate a wide roster of independent baseline, defensive, and tactical strategies, identify repeatable conditional strengths, and measure tactical value relative to the baseline temporarily displaced.

roles.baseline_candidate: Strategies intended to hold capital through persistent conditions.
roles.defensive_override: Strategies intended to reduce or redirect risk temporarily during adverse conditions.
roles.tactical_opportunity: Short-horizon strategies that must outperform the baseline over the same interval.
roles.hybrid_control: Earlier combined concepts retained only as research controls, not proposed routers.

evaluation.tactical_primary_metric: incremental return versus the displaced baseline
evaluation.required_recurrence: at least three calendar years plus chronological-fold evidence
